quote.text: Though the Earth, and all inferior Creatures be common to all Men, yet every Man has a Property in his own Person.
quote.author: John Locke, Second Treatise of Government (1689), ch. V, §27

stories.headline: Fredericia’s Mogensen chair survives 200,000 loaded sittings in Danish test
stories.dek: The Danish Technological Institute passed the oak 3236 at its prison-grade level in tests ending 12 May 2026; Carl Hansen’s own sheet for a Wegner chair caps the sitter at 110kg.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3bn, closes Nasdaq debut 17% higher
stories.dek: Shares opened on Nasdaq at 111.50 dollars on 19 November and ended at 97.17; on the 13.2 billion shares the final prospectus counts, the close values the company near 1.28 trillion dollars.

stories.headline: Hong Kong’s Victoria Harbour Race marks 120 years with 4,000 swimmers
stories.dek: The 15 November crossing ran one kilometre from Wan Chai to Tsim Sha Tsui; England’s Active Lives survey counts 2.45 million adults who prefer open water to a pool.

stories.headline: Xi, Putin and Trump issue four-point Shenzhen peace declaration
stories.dek: The 19 November text promises nuclear-risk talks and a curb on the International Criminal Court, but never names Ukraine or Iran.

stories.headline: America’s chip-licence rule for Singapore takes effect
stories.dek: The Commerce Department’s rule, printed on 19 November, lets shipments already under way finish by 21 December, takes comments until 19 January, and expects only about 100 extra licence applications a year.

stories.headline: Pebble’s US$75 voice ring earns an eight from Engadget
stories.dek: Daniel Cooper’s review on 19 November backs a ring that is never charged — its sealed cell lasts two to three years — just as Pebble says the price will rise to US$99.

stories.headline: Nomos turns three Bauhaus classics black and gold
stories.dek: The Noir series, shown on 19 November, adds six permanent references from €1,940 in steel to €9,800 in gold; Nomos’s US store asks US$12,500 for the gold Tangente.

stories.headline: Disney+ opens Percy Jackson’s third season on a perfect score
stories.dek: Two episodes of The Titan’s Curse arrive on 20 November, with the finale on 11 December; Rotten Tomatoes shows 100 per cent from ten reviews.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Guilt And Love Withdrawal
stories.headline: Parents’ guilt-tripping fades from 12 to 16, Duke-led study finds
stories.dek: Parenting Across Cultures, run from Duke by Jennifer Lansford, tracked the parents of 1,338 children over five yearly waves; a sister paper found teenagers guilt-tripped at 13 told their parents less by 16.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The AI Sell-Off
stories.headline: S&P 500 sinks below its 200-day line on Anthropic’s debut
stories.dek: On 19 November the Nasdaq fell 2.2 per cent and Wall Street’s fear gauge neared 29, its highest since March, while the ten-year Treasury yield slipped to 5.04 per cent.

stories.headline: Only hard training lifts a bone marker, Semmelweis review finds
stories.dek: Viktória Barna’s team pooled 24 trials and 1,238 adults; handball and football played above 85 per cent of maximum heart rate moved osteocalcin, walking did not.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Wonderland, Leonardo And Comiket
stories.headline: Christmas Wonderland opens 27 November with S$9 advance tickets
stories.dek: Children aged 3 to 12 pay S$7 at Gardens by the Bay; in Tokyo, Leonardo’s La Belle Ferronnière, shown in Japan for the first time, leaves Roppongi on 13 December.

stories.headline: Tokyo court protects Kenjiro Tsuda’s voice, then rejects his claim
stories.dek: “Voice rights” made Japan’s word-of-the-year shortlist on 5 November, after a 30 September ruling for voice actor Kenjiro Tsuda — who still lost his case.
